title: Contact
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Assampedia is a small personal project with no contact form and no support desk.

Suggest a correction

The best way to suggest a correction is to open the article and use its Talk tab, where readers can note errors, missing sections or new sources to add.

What to include

When suggesting a change, mention the article name, the section, what is wrong, and — if you have one — the source that supports the correction.
